design_freeze: proposed, not yet sealed for independent future data
discovery_video_role: EXPLORATORY_ONLY; not a blind test; filenames, pulse window, and visible patterns already known

hypotheses.H0: passive bubble transport / advection / surface response without separately measured propagating phasefront
hypotheses.H1: radially structured inertial-mode response to disk pulse
hypotheses.H2: distinct torsional wave response with repeatable non-advective phase lag
hypotheses.H3: physical SST finite-core axial torsion mode derived from inviscid dynamics; separate later experiment

design: randomized runs, identical baseline spin, independent unsealed motor log only in REVEAL, >=8 valid repeats per condition target
blinded_inputs: side+top synchronized videos with coded trial IDs

gates.G0: provenance SHA-256, frame timing, synchronization and blind isolation PASS
gates.G1: spatial calibration/refraction and boundary geometry qualified
gates.G2: rotor waveform and exact time zero independently known
gates.G3: bubble velocities separately measured; wavefront must be independently registered
gates.G5: time-of-arrival phase lag across >=3 heights; front velocity confidence interval finite and directed
gates.G6: test inertial frequency bound |omega| <= 2*Omega0 in co-rotating frame and radial mode dependence
gates.G7: compare advection, viscous diffusion, and dispersive-wave model; prevent model-selection leakage
gates.G8: independent free-surface height field vs bubble concentration
gates.G9: top view helicity/azimuthal mode m quantified separately
gates.G10: independent inviscid PKLSA finite-core test only after laboratory classification is frozen
gates.G11: clock/light implications unresolved until microscopic phase and photon-mode closure

explicit_forbidden_calibrations: posthoc selection of a single 50-degree k-vector
success_definition: Repeatable, independent phase-delay across heights not explained by tracked tracer advection, plus qualified inertial-mode comparison. Physics beyond that unresolved.
limits: single-side-view observational clip cannot recover 3D phase speed
local fluid lab time is not experimentally proven SST absolute cosmological time
